title: Commit OS Core JS Protocol Surface
description:
framework/product/os/core/js/index.ts carries a stale header docstring claiming to be a "minimal JS surface for OS program registration until full port lands." Investigation shows this is stale: the file contains a dead region (programDefinitions map, osBaselineResource, mergeOsProgramDefinition, registerAppVcsHandler, osOutPort, osInPort, and the OsProgramResourceMap type) with zero live consumers outside this file's own inline tests — the real OS kernel (media graph, program registry, ops) lives entirely in Rust/wasm at framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs, consumed by the shell only through the s-plugin wasm boundary. The live part of this JS file is the sync/backbone protocol surface (buildFrameworkSyncUtilities, BackboneWorkerRequest/Response, PersistenceBinding, OpEnvelope helpers) used by framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx and framework/product/os/dev/script.ts.

Task: grep the repo to independently confirm zero live call sites for the dead symbols, delete the dead region, rewrite the header docstring to state plainly that this package is JS sync/backbone protocol surface only and the OS kernel is Rust/wasm-only with no JS port planned, remove the now-dangling inline tests for the deleted exports, then run typecheck/test for this package and the two live consumers to confirm nothing broke.
summary:
Investigated framework/product/os/core/js/index.ts's stale "minimal JS surface for OS program registration until full port lands" header against a repo-wide grep and found the ticket's premise only half-held: two of the six flagged symbols were confirmed dead, but four were not.

Confirmed dead (deleted, lines 22-28 of the original file): `osOutPort(resourceKind, id, label)` and `osInPort(resourceKind, id, label, required)`. Zero references anywhere in checked-in application source; the only hits were inside other tickets' scratch/generator scripts under `.repo/🎫/26/07/03/APP-ISOLATION-ENFORCED-BOUNDARIES/*.ts` and another agent's worktree scratch (`.claude/worktrees/agent-.../…`), neither of which are live app code.

NOT dead, left in place: `programDefinitions` (Map), `vcsHandlers` (Set), `osBaselineResource`, `mergeOsProgramDefinition`, `registerAppVcsHandler`, and the `OsProgramResourceMap` type. `compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts:17422-17471` (`//#region 🔖OsProgram`, real git-tracked source, not a scratch file) imports all three functions from `@semio-tech/framework-os-core` and calls them inside `sketchpadProgramContribution.register()`. Deleting them would break a real, checked-in consumer, so per the ticket's explicit fallback instruction I left them and report it here instead.

Caveat for whoever owns that compose region next: it currently does not compile for reasons unrelated to this ticket — it also imports `createTypedAppVcsHandler` from `@semio-tech/framework-os-core` (no such export exists anywhere in the repo) and `OsProgramContribution` from `@semio-tech/framework-platform-core` (that package doesn't exist anywhere in the repo), and calls `osBaselineResource(...)` with 4 arguments against its current 3-parameter signature. `sketchpadProgramContribution` itself also has zero importers repo-wide. This looks like unfinished/abandoned output from a prior "APP-ISOLATION-ENFORCED-BOUNDARIES" migration (its ticket folder has no ticket.json, only leftover generator scripts). I did not touch compose or attempt to fix this — out of scope for this ticket.

Header docstring (lines 1-12) rewritten to state accurately: this package is primarily the JS sync/backbone protocol surface (backbone URIs, envelopes, backbone-worker wire types, PersistenceBinding/OpEnvelope, buildFrameworkSyncUtilities) consumed by os-shell.tsx and os/dev/script.ts; the OS kernel (media graph, program registry, ops) is Rust/wasm-only via the s-plugin wasm boundary and this file is not a JS port of it; and it flags the remaining osBaselineResource/mergeOsProgramDefinition/registerAppVcsHandler trio as a legacy shim kept only for the compose consumer, not to be extended.

Inline tests updated: removed the `osOutPort`/`osInPort` assertions from the "builds baseline resources and ports" test, renamed to "builds baseline resources", kept the `osBaselineResource` assertion. No other test regions touched.

Verification: `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-os-core:test` — 26/26 tests pass. Grepped os-shell.tsx (`framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx:280-292`) and os/dev/script.ts (`framework/product/os/dev/script.ts` import block) — both consumers' imported symbols (FRAMEWORK_SYNC_CONTROLLER_ID, buildFileBackboneUri, buildFolderBackboneUri, buildFrameworkSyncUtilities, buildRemoteBackboneUri, BackboneWorkerRequest, BackboneWorkerResponse, DocumentActorMsg, DocumentSyncStatus, FrameworkSyncUtilityLeaf, PersistenceBinding, BACKBONE_ENDPOINT_PATH, backboneKindFromUri) are untouched and still exported. Neither project has a dedicated `:typecheck` nx target (no repo-wide convention exists beyond one unrelated project); ran their `:test`/`:lint` targets instead — both fail, but for causes independently verified as pre-existing and unrelated to this change: framework-renderer-react's vitest run fails because `components/puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx` is currently deleted in the working tree by a concurrent, unrelated edit (`git status` shows `D framework/renderer/react/components/puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx`); framework-os-dev has no `vitest.config.ts` file at all (pre-existing infra gap, not something this ticket should create).
